title: edge-case handling in telemetry
requirement: telemetry handles empty, oversized and malformed inputs without corrupting state (area: Recovery, reliability and release management).
acceptance_criterion: no corruption; a clear error is returned; state remains consistent
verification_method: test with empty / oversized / malformed fixtures

title: authorization for telemetry
requirement: only authorized roles may trigger telemetry; object access is checked server-side (area: Recovery, reliability and release management).
acceptance_criterion: unauthorized callers receive 401/404 and nothing changes
verification_method: permission test with second user / anonymous client

title: durability and recovery of telemetry
requirement: telemetry results survive an application restart and are reconciled with reality (area: Recovery, reliability and release management).
acceptance_criterion: state matches persisted records after restart; no orphaned resources
verification_method: restart-recovery test or documented manual procedure

title: observability of telemetry
requirement: telemetry emits structured logs/audit events and exposes measurable status (area: Recovery, reliability and release management).
acceptance_criterion: the audit trail contains the event and status reflects reality
verification_method: assert audit/log records exist in the test suite
